findings: app_server_goal.py emits ACK only after verified initial turn/start and directly waits for Goal/turn notifications
single Work Unit route has no heartbeat-based supervisor or process-death reinvocation owner
Work Package supervisor consumes ACK and heartbeat but forwards intermediate events to stdout
agents-main currently directs the model to monitor forwarded heartbeat/events for Work Packages
focused app_server_goal and main contract tests passed before this change
interpretations: ACK alone does not prove continuing progress
forwarding routine heartbeat and logs into the main LLM context conflicts with the Human token-minimization requirement

content.question: Goal + Exec의 진행 추적 기준을 어디까지 요구합니까?
content.rationale: 메인 에이전트의 반복 감시 없이 낮은 컨텍스트 사용량과 신뢰성 있는 실행 추적을 함께 달성한다.
choices: A: 요청 시 Goal·프로세스·Work Unit·최근 heartbeat를 종합 조회하고 재접속 시 reconciliation 지원
B: 현재 ACK·canonical 진행 기록·terminal만으로 완료
C: 실시간 진행 UI와 지속 알림 제공
